document.title: PER-3/PJ/2026: Tata cara penyampaian, penerimaan, dan pengolahan SPT

delta.note: This DGT regulation governs only administrative procedures for submitting, receiving, and processing tax returns (SPT). It covers deadlines, extensions, electronic filing, verification, and SPT exemptions. It does not change any PPh 21 rate, threshold, PTKP, deduction, table, or calculation step for permanent employees. References to PPh 21 withholding slips and to overpayment treatment are purely administrative or reporting matters.
